title: Complete Contest Preparation (1979)
author: Mithosphere
desc:
Phase 1: 6 to 3 Months Out (Preparation)
Stage 1: Planning
Competitors must target specific peak dates. Peaking multiple times a year causes excessive physical strain.
Stage 2: Cardio
Essential as age slows metabolism and forms subcutaneous fat. It builds circulation and capillary action for muscle growth.
- 4 months: Run 3x/week
- 3 months: Run 4x/week
- 2 months: Run 4-5x/week
- 1 month: Run 1-2x daily (1-1.5 miles per session)
Stage 3: Nutrition
- 6 Months: Switch regular milk to watered-down non-fat powdered milk for protein drinks to drop fat.
- 5 Months: Replace watered milk with water and morning OJ. Limit bread to 3 slices daily. Focus on fruit, cottage cheese, eggs, lean meat, fish, and tuna. Allow one cheat meal/week. Taboo: soda, fries, donuts, white bread, sugar.
- 4 Months: Re-evaluate; drop cheat meals and limit high-cholesterol foods (bacon, sausage) if needed.
Stage 4: Supplements
Used to complement, never replace, meals.
- 6 Months: Desiccated liver, wheat germ oil, B-complex, multi-vitamin, protein powder.
- 5 Months: Add lecithin.
- 4 Months: Increase lecithin; add ginseng, B-15, vitamins D and E.
Stage 5: Training
Use heavy, conventional barbell training for drug-free mass and power. Perform 2 exercises per body part for 5–6 sets, twice weekly. Warm up with 2 sets of 15 reps at 50% max weight. Train with maximum intensity and log every workout.

Phase 2: 3 Months to Peak
Stage 1: Reevaluation
Use an objective mirror or photos—not friends' advice—to identify flaws in proportion, shape, and separation. Adjust exercises to target weaker body parts.
Stage 2: Tanning & Dehydration
Build a real sun tan to shed water through pores. At 3 weeks out, take an herbal diuretic, 1 tsp apple cider vinegar, and a kelp/vinegar/B6 tablet with every meal. Reduce water gradually. Drink 2 pints daily during the last 2 days, and only mouth-moistening sips on the final day.
Stage 3: Nutrition
To shock the system at 3 months out, take 5 days completely off training and supplements. Fast for the final 3 days on just 2 pieces of fruit daily, 4 wheat bran tablets, salad, and water to shrink the stomach.
- Resume training with 5 small daily meals of lean meats, chicken, eggs, fish, and fruit. Avoid bloating.
- Eliminate sandwich bread 4 weeks out. Use fruit enzymes for energy and digestion. Cap calories at 15 per pound of body weight (3,000 calories for a 200 lb man).
Stage 4: Supplementation
• Switch to liquid pre-digested protein, transitioning strictly to milk/egg protein with water in the final month - 150–175g total daily. Take 10–12 desiccated liver tablets 4x daily. Take the following 4x daily with meals: 2 tbsp Energol, 1 cap Ginseng, 8 tabs Kelp, 4 caps Lecithin, 400U Vitamin E , 1x B-Complex, 1x Pituitary Adrenal Gland, 1x B-15, 500mg Vitamin C.
Stage 5: Training
Shift to an intermediate 6-day split. Pair one heavy mass-building exercise with a • superset of two shape/definition movements, focusing • heavily on lagging areas.
